chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding the words of Yaʿqūb to his sons:
"I will seek forgiveness for you from my Lord."
He said: "He delayed it until the sahar, on the night of Jumuʿah."

key_terms.أَخَّرَهَا: he delayed it; postponed the act of seeking forgiveness
key_terms.أَسْتَغْفِرُ: I seek forgiveness; here, asking Allah for pardon on behalf of others
key_terms.رَبِّي: my Lord; the One from whom forgiveness is sought
key_terms.لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the night of Friday, a spiritually distinguished time

ai.seo_question: Why did Prophet Yaʿqūb delay seeking forgiveness for his sons?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse about Prophet Yaʿqūb’s promise to seek forgiveness for his sons as referring to a delayed supplication at a specially virtuous time. It indicates the spiritual significance of the pre-dawn hours of the night of Jumuʿah as a time suited for seeking forgiveness.
